title: Spotting Fake Fertilizer Bags
problem: Fraudulent traders sell fake fertilizer bags with duplicate company logos that fail to grow crops and waste farmers' hard-earned savings.
idea: A real-versus-fake check card. Before buying, the farmer ticks the checks on the bag and the shop. If many checks fail, the page warns him.

widgets.heading: ✅ Try it: Check the bag before you pay
widgets.intro: Tick every point that is TRUE for the bag in front of you.

items.text: Bought from a licensed dealer shop
Company name and address printed clearly
Batch number and manufacturing date printed
MRP printed and I paid not more than MRP
Got a printed bill (POS machine slip)
Spelling of brand name is correct

bands.text: Looks genuine. Keep the bill safely.
Some checks missing. Ask the dealer before using.
Danger! This may be fake. Do not use it. Tell the Agriculture Officer.

items.title: Scan the logo
items.text: Use Google Lens to compare the logo with the company's real website.
items.te: గూగుల్ లెన్స్‌తో లోగోను కంపెనీ అసలు లోగోతో పోల్చండి.

items.title: Always take a bill
items.text: A bill helps you complain and get money back.

items.title: Too cheap = danger
items.text: If the price is much lower than MRP, be careful.
items.te: ఎంఆర్‌పీ కంటే చాలా తక్కువ ధర అయితే జాగ్రత్త.

items.title: Report it
items.text: Tell the Agriculture Extension Officer about doubtful bags.
items.te: అనుమానం ఉన్న బస్తాల గురించి వ్యవసాయ అధికారికి చెప్పండి.

questions.q: A man on a bike sells urea cheaper than MRP without a bill. Buy?
options: No, buy only from a licensed dealer with a bill
questions.why: Unlicensed sellers may sell fake products, and you cannot complain without a bill.

questions.q: What must be printed on a real bag?
options: Batch number, date, MRP, company address
questions.why: Genuine bags show these details clearly.

questions.q: Whom do we tell about fake fertilizer?
questions.why: Officers can test samples and take action against fake sellers.

how: Take photos of a real fertilizer bag's logo and printed details at a licensed shop.
Use Google Lens to compare the logo with the company's official website.
Ask Gemini to list the details every genuine bag must have.
Make a 'Real vs Fake' list with Gemini in English and Telugu.
Design pocket-size check cards in Canva with clear photos.
Get the cards checked by the Agriculture Officer and share them at Rythu Vedika.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Help me make a simple check card for farmers to spot fake fertilizer bags. List 7 things to check on the bag and at the shop (licensed dealer, batch number, date, MRP, seal, bill). Write it in simple English and Telugu, and say to report doubtful bags to the Agriculture Extension Officer.
